descriptionChirho: Abstract authority or power exercised over persons or things, the ability or capability to act with force or control.
The right, entitlement, or liberty to do something, emphasizing warrant or permission rather than raw power.
Authorities as concrete entities — rulers, governing powers, or supernatural principalities that wield dominion (typically plural).
The sphere, territory, or domain over which authority extends; a bounded area of governmental or legal control.
